findings.title: Required regression verification is incomplete
findings.detail: The verification contract marks the required regression check passes:false and states the full tests/run-all.sh execution timed out. Scoped substitute runs do not verify the required full regression surface, so task completion cannot be established.

findings.title: Required placeholder scan fails without the mandated acceptance
findings.detail: The verification contract marks placeholder-scan passes:false. Its evidence reports five findings, and the bundle explicitly states that no quality-gate report records the human acceptance required by the scanner for those findings. Pre-existing findings remain unresolved verification failures absent that acceptance.

findings.title: Verification contract is bound to a stale specification revision
findings.detail: The contract's spec_revision is 2740928c9e9c45cd56644a0e22e4fb5fc3c270932eba9c8fecf4a8450780d437, while its own disclosure says the current requirements/design/acceptance-tests digest is 466465e04248cb912635ed83435ff0c17e9805648e0caead7132ad6276a34d23 after later amendments. No fresh independent gate over the current specification is evidenced, creating unverified spec drift.
